info.title: Video Agent API
info.description: Make videos from a prompt with Netlify Agent Runners and HyperFrames. Everything the web app does is in this API: authenticate with a key from the [API keys](/keys) page.

tags.name: videos
tags.description: Create a video from a prompt, list and update videos, and follow a run while it works.

tags.name: versions
tags.description: Revise a video into its next version, retry or cancel one, and download its files.

tags.name: planning
tags.description: Plan before creating: a few questions, then an editable brief to create the video with.

tags.name: editor
tags.description: Edit a finished version in the browser: open a draft, save edits, preview and render them.

tags.name: publishing
tags.description: Give a version a public share page, MP4, GIF and embed links, or take them down.

tags.name: review
tags.description: Comments pinned to moments in a video, and approvals.

tags.name: media
tags.description: The team's media library: uploads, music from Openverse and captions.

tags.name: notifications
tags.description: Comments and approvals on your videos.

tags.name: keys
tags.description: API keys, connected OAuth apps and your webhook.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: People and roles, the team webhook, transfers, stats and the queue. Admins only.

tags.name: system
tags.description: Health and public configuration. No sign-in needed.

bearerAuth.description: API key: nva_<keyId>_<secret>, created in the web app.

cookieAuth.name: nf_jwt
cookieAuth.description: The web app session (Netlify Identity). State-changing requests must be same-origin.

planningAvailable.description: AI Gateway is available, so Plan it first is offered.

mcpOAuth.description: MCP clients can connect with OAuth (Sign in with Netlify) as well as API keys.

authProvider.description: How people sign in to the web app: Netlify Identity, or Sign in with Netlify.

requiredTeams.description: Netlify teams (slugs or ids) a Netlify sign-in must belong to; empty when there is no team rule.

narrationEnabled.description: Recorded voice-over is on, so the Narration track and Record are offered.

remixEnabled.description: Remixing is on, so Remix is offered to people who can create videos.

missingSettings.description: Required settings this deployment doesn't have yet (names only), so the sign-in screen and the app can say what to add. Empty once it's set up.

unread.description: Others' comments since you last read them

isRemix.description: This video was remixed from another one

remixOf.description: The video (and version) this one was remixed from, when you can see it

favorite.description: You starred this video (only you see your favorites)

plan.description: The plan accepted before this version was made, if any.

incorporates.description: How many comments this version was asked to incorporate.

editable.description: Ready and keeps editing contract v1, so it can be edited in the browser.

mode.description: render_unchanged: an edit made in the browser, rendered as is (no agent authoring). author: an agent run, including an edit fitted to its recorded narration (editedFromN set).

editedFromN.description: The version an edit made in the browser started from: rendered as is, or (mode author) fitted to its recorded narration.

voiceover.description: The voice-over, or null when there is none.

notices.description: Things to know about the video, kept despite them, e.g. a length far from the one asked for

narrationAudio.description: The recorded narration as a 192 kbps MP3; only versions with recorded narration.

transcript.description: The narration's transcript as plain text (the latest caption revision); only when there is one.

posterSources.description: Smaller poster images (480 and 960 px wide), best format first, ready for <picture><source>. Only for versions rendered with them.

clip.description: A short muted preview clip (480 px wide, a few seconds), best format first, ready for <video><source>. Use instead of the GIF when present.

lqip.description: A tiny blurred poster as a data URI, to show while the poster loads.

files.description: Signed URLs for the poster and preview GIF, once the version has files (30 to 60 minutes; 5 to 10 for private videos). Use links for a fresh one.

credits.description: CC BY media this version was made with (Openverse music from the library, or fetched by the run itself): show the credit wherever the video is shown

Sound.description: silent: no audio (the default). music: a music bed (a picked audio item, else the brand music in context/, else none). music_sfx: music plus sound effects on visible actions.

title.description: The chosen track's title, once one is chosen

mediaId.description: The library item the track became, once picked

source.description: Where the picked track came from: an Openverse search, or the team's library when Openverse found none in time. Null until picked

outcome.description: searching: in progress. failed: Openverse didn't answer. empty: nothing importable. chosen: a track was chosen from it. import_failed: that track couldn't be imported

tried.description: The Openverse searches tried so far, in order (at most 7)

MusicPick.description: The music the server picked before the run (null when none was needed).

status.description: How the narration's transcription went; anything but ok means no narration cues.

policy.description: Burned-in captions are corrected by rendering again.

rev.description: Bumped by every correction; send it back as expectedRev.

VersionCaptions.description: Recorded narration captions and their current correction; null: the render’s own captions.

mediaId.description: The library item, or null for music or a sound effect the run fetched from Openverse itself

sourceUrl.description: The work on its source site

text.example: "Calm Piano" by Ada, CC BY 4.0, https://www.jamendo.com/track/1

posterWebp.description: A 960px-wide WebP poster, for versions rendered with preview variants.

narration.description: The recorded narration as an MP3, for versions that have one.

transcript.description: The narration's transcript as plain text, when the publication shows it.

showTranscript.description: Whether the share page offers the narration's transcript.

embed.description: HTML to embed the video; with CC BY media it includes the credit line as a caption

Language.description: The language spoken in the video (BCP-47 primary subtag): recorded narration is transcribed for captions in it. The local transcriber covers the European languages; the others need ElevenLabs.

prompt.example: A 20-second launch video for our new webhooks feature

durationSec.description: Target length in seconds. Omit for Auto.

planId.description: A plan from POST /api/v1/plans; its brief is added to the run. Optional.

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL for video.ready / video.failed events (API keys only).

mediaIds.description: Library items (GET /api/v1/media) the agent should use: images, clips, fonts, audio.

allOf.description: Omit for the plan's choice, else music when an audio item is picked, else silent.

voice.description: A Kokoro voice (af_heart, af_nova, af_sky, am_adam, am_michael, bf_emma, bf_isabella, bm_george, …) or, when the deployment has an ElevenLabs key, an ElevenLabs voice id. Default: af_heart (or the ElevenLabs default).

script.description: The narration, one line per beat in order, spoken word for word. Omit to let the plan's narration or the agent write it.

VoiceoverInput.description: A spoken narration with captions from its words. Omit for the plan's choice, else none.

mediaIds.description: Library items (GET /api/v1/media) the agent should use: images, clips, fonts, audio.

allOf.description: Omit to keep the revised version's sound (or the plan's choice; a new audio pick on a silent video turns on music).
Omit to keep the revised version's voice-over (or the plan's choice); unchanged lines keep their audio.

commentIds.description: Incorporate feedback: open comments on the version being revised (owner or admin). prompt is your note.

prompt.description: What to change: anything from swapping a name to the same format on a new topic.
prompt.example: Same video, but for our payments API instead of webhooks.

fromVersion.description: The version to remix. Omit for the latest ready one.

allOf.description: Omit to keep the source's shape.
Omit to keep the source's language.

durationSec.description: Target length in seconds. Omit to keep the source's.

allOf.description: Omit to keep the source's sound.
Omit to keep the source's AI voice-over settings. Recorded narration is never carried over.

mediaIds.description: The remix's library media: replaces the source's set. Omit to keep the source's set.

planId.description: A plan made with remixOf for this same video and version.

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL for video.ready / video.failed events (API keys only).

title.description: The name given in the library; null shows the file name

caption.description: Notes on the item. The planner and the agent read them.

usedIn.description: Videos you can see that use it

urls.description: Signed for 10 minutes; null until the item is ready

url.description: The landing page of the work

creditRequired.description: True for CC BY: videos that use it credit it (CC0 needs no credit)

MediaSource.description: Where an imported item came from (Openverse), with its licence; null for uploads

role.description: A voice-over recording (take) or uploaded narration

videoId.description: The video it was made for; null if you can no longer see it

usedIn.description: Versions of videos you can see, and your own drafts, that use it

retainUntil.description: When it's deleted if nothing uses it by then; null while a draft or version uses it

Recording.description: For a voice-over recording: its video, where it is used and how long it is kept; null otherwise

showTranscript.description: Offer the narration's transcript on the share page. Default off; publishing again changes only this.

expectedRev.description: The revision the corrections are based on (versions[].captions.rev).

cues.description: Every cue of the current captions, in order, with the same ids and timings; only text may change.

seq.description: For live=1: the checkpoint this snapshot is from

webhookSecret.description: Signs webhooks for videos created with this key. Shown once.

signInMethods.description: How the person signs in: 'identity' (Netlify Identity) and/or 'netlify' (Sign in with Netlify).

secret.description: Shown only when the webhook is created or rotated.

narrationEnabled.description: Recorded voice-over is on (the default). Off hides recording and refuses narration changes; versions that already have narration keep playing.

takeQuotaBytes.description: Stored bytes each person's recordings may use (default 2 GiB).

remixEnabled.description: Remixing is on (the default). Off hides every Remix button and refuses new remixes; queued ones still run.

TranscriptionProvider.description: How recorded narration is transcribed for captions: local (the default, audio stays in this deployment), elevenlabs (sends the audio to ElevenLabs) or off (no captions from recordings).

remixOf.description: The video and version this plan remixes, for a remix plan.

recommended.description: The planner's recommended option; it is listed first.

allOf.description: The Sound chosen while planning, if any.

voiceover.description: The voice-over chosen while planning, if any; the brief then has narration per beat.

remixOf.description: Plan a remix of this video (and version, else its latest ready one); not with revisionOf.

mediaIds.description: Library items to plan around. The planner sees the first few images; the video made from this plan uses them all.

briefRev.description: The briefRev you loaded; the save is refused if it changed (If-Match also works).

step.description: The agent's latest step, in its own words

allOf.description: The music the server is picking (or picked) before the run; null when none was needed.

steps.description: Agent steps so far (a count, not a percentage)

observedAt.description: When the run was last read (null: from stored rows)

stale.description: True when the run couldn't be read and this is the last known value

checkpoint.description: The latest milestone the run reported itself

src.description: A ready audio item from the library, as assets/media/<media id>.<ext>

oneOf.description: Swap an audio track's file, set its level or mute it, by its id
Change a voiced beat's narration line (plain text). The draft preview keeps the old audio; the render re-voices the line, lengthening the beat only if the new line no longer fits

newerVersion.description: A newer version exists: start from it, or render this draft as the next version

yoursReplaces.description: The draft has its own narration: rendering it replaces that version's (warn before rendering)

narrationChanged.description: The newest ready version's narration differs from this draft's base: rebase onto it (rebase-narration), or keep yours

id.description: Stable slot id; a split piece gets <id>~n

srcEnd.description: Source sample after the last; > srcStart

fit.description: Recording alignment, t = a + b·sample (identity for uploads); provenance

gainDb.description: Clip gain in dB; null is silent

alternatives.description: The slot's other takes, oldest first, the clip's own left out; a render plays only the clip's own take

take.description: With alternatives: the clip's own take number in its slot (default: the newest)

NarrationOp.description: The whole recorded narration track (at most one per draft): clips of takes placed in integer samples at 24 kHz; later clips win where they overlap

fit.description: Recording alignment, t = a + b·sample (identity for uploads); provenance

offsetSamples.description: With the fit, where this take sounds: placeTake(fit, offsetSamples, srcStart)

TakeAlternative.description: Another take of a clip's slot (an earlier punch-in over the same range); draft-only

voice.description: The beat's AI voice-over clip, in seconds into the beat; null when it has none. A changed line may lengthen its beat when re-voiced

volume.description: The level set (a gain: 1 is as authored, up to 4), kept while muted

beat.description: The beat it plays in; null for music and narration

revoice.description: The line changed since it was spoken; the render re-voices it

narration.description: Each voiced beat's narration line, in beat order

src.description: A ready audio item from the library, as assets/media/<media id>.<ext>

oneOf.description: Swap an audio track's file, set its level or mute it, by its id
Change a voiced beat's narration line (plain text). The draft preview keeps the old audio; the render re-voices the line, lengthening the beat only if the new line no longer fits

mode.description: keep_visuals (default): render the draft as is, recorded narration mixed over it. fit_to_narration: an authoring run (about 250 credits) retimes the visuals from the draft to the narration, which it cannot change; it always replaces the AI voice-over, and needs recorded narration in the draft (no holdFinalFrame or excludeNarration)

holdFinalFrame.description: Narration that runs past the end holds the last frame, plus 0.5 s, instead of being cut off

captions.description: How narration captions are delivered: a VTT sidecar (default) or burned in

excludeNarration.description: Render picture first: render the draft's other edits without its recorded narration, so you can record against the new picture. The narration stays in the draft; move it onto the new version with rebase-narration

toN.description: The version to move your narration onto

draftId.description: The holder's draft (shown to the holder only)

expiresAt.description: The lock is free from then on unless the holder heartbeats (every 30 s)

NarrationLockHolder.description: Who is editing the narration; null when no one is

heartbeat.description: You believe you hold the lock (a heartbeat): if someone took it over, the 409 says who (details.takenOverBy, details.at)

allOf.description: Who held it before you; null when no one did

uploaded.description: Part indexes already received (resume from here)

role.description: A voice-over recording (take) or uploaded narration; null for library uploads

scopeJobId.description: The video a recording is for

fetchedAt.description: When these tracks were fetched from Openverse (searches are shared and stored)

stale.description: True when the stored search is over a day old: it is answered at once and refreshed in the background

id.description: Openverse audio id (pass it to import)

landingUrl.description: The work on its source site

previewUrl.description: The provider's file (https), to listen to before importing

importable.description: False when no file fits the library (type, 50 MB, 10 minutes)

mediaId.description: The library item, when it was already imported

id.description: Poll GET /api/v1/media/openverse/jobs/{id} until done or failed

created.description: A finished import: false when the track was already in the library

expiresAt.description: The job can be read until then (30 minutes)

items.description: Ready audio in the library matching the words, Openverse imports first

samples.description: Source length in samples at 24 kHz

version.description: The VAD version the spans were measured with

spans.description: Speech as [start, end) in source samples at 24 kHz, in order, not overlapping

samples.description: The recording's length in samples at 24 kHz (filled in when it's checked)

unreadCount.description: Others' comments on this video since you last read

x.description: 0–1 across the displayed video, letterboxing excluded

y.description: 0–1 down the displayed video, letterboxing excluded

groupId.description: Notes posted together as one review block share this id; null for a lone comment

notes.description: Notes from one pass through the video, each optionally at a moment and a spot; posted as one block.

planningCredits.description: Estimated AI Gateway credits for planning (Plan it first).

planningUnknown.description: Planning calls whose cost is unknown (errors, timeouts).

get.description: Liveness and setup readiness. Never returns secrets.
Public configuration for the sign-in screen.

post.description: Creates a video from a prompt and queues its first version.

get.description: Lists videos, newest first.

put.description: Adds the video to your favorites. Favorites are per person: only you see them. Idempotent.

delete.description: Removes the video from your favorites. Idempotent.

get.description: One video with its versions.

patch.description: Renames a video, makes it private, or sets the language spoken in it (for narration captions).

delete.description: Deletes a video, its versions, files and public links.

202.description: Deleted; files are removed in the background

post.description: Starts the next version from a ready one.

Makes a NEW video, owned by you, that starts from this video's finished composition (a ready version) and changes it as the prompt says: anything from swapping a name to the same format on a new topic. Its shape, length, sound, AI voice-over and library media come from the source unless you set them; recorded narration, comments and publications don't carry over. A private video's remix is private. Returns the new video.

409.description: Not ready, remixing turned off by an admin (remix_disabled), or a key reused

get.description: The library items a version was made with, in order (items since deleted from the library included). A remix keeps them unless you pass mediaIds.

post.description: Tries a failed, cancelled or timed-out version again.
Stops a version in progress.
Publishes a version to a public share page and links. With showTranscript, the share page offers the narration's transcript.

delete.description: Takes a version's public links down; they stop working on the next request.

put.description: Approve a version or request changes; null clears your verdict. Not allowed on your own version.

post.description: Corrects recorded narration's caption text without a render: every cue, in order, with its id and timing unchanged. The captions and transcript get new revision files; the share page follows. Owner or admin. 409 when expectedRev isn't the current revision or the captions are burned in.

get.description: A short-lived link to play a ready version's composition in the sandboxed preview. With live=1, a running version's latest snapshot.
Redirects to a signed URL valid for 5 to 10 minutes.

put.description: Admins only. Adds a preview variant (or the placeholder, name lqip) to a ready version that doesn't have it yet.

get.description: Your API keys.

post.description: Creates an API key. Its secret is shown once.

delete.description: Revokes an API key; requests with it stop working.

get.description: Your connected OAuth apps. 404 when MCP OAuth is off.

delete.description: Disconnects an OAuth app; its tokens stop working.

get.description: Who you are: your account and role.
Everyone who has signed in, with their roles. Admins only.

patch.description: Changes a role, or disables or enables a user. Admins only.

get.description: Your webhook, for events on videos you own.

put.description: Sets your webhook URL. A signing secret is returned once, on create or rotate.

delete.description: Removes your webhook; pending deliveries to it are dropped.

post.description: Sends a signed webhook.test event to your webhook now.

get.description: The team webhook, for events on every video. Admins only.

put.description: Sets the team webhook URL. A signing secret is returned once, on create or rotate. Admins only.

delete.description: Removes the team webhook; pending deliveries to it are dropped. Admins only.

post.description: Sends a signed webhook.test event to the team webhook now. Admins only.

get.description: Settings an admin can change without a redeploy: recorded voice-over. Admins only.

patch.description: Changes the settings given; leave a field out to keep it. Takes effect at once. Admins only.

post.description: Starts planning a video: a fast router decides whether a few questions would help.

get.description: One of your plans.

patch.description: Saves your edits to the brief. Send the briefRev you loaded.

post.description: Zero to six multiple-choice questions about the video; empty when the prompt covers it.
Turns the answers into an editable brief.

get.description: Your credits this month: agent runs and planning (estimates).
Comments and approvals on your videos, newest first, with an unread count.

post.description: Marks notifications read: all, or up to a time.

get.description: Live progress of the latest version's run: the agent's step, steps and credits so far.

post.description: Opens your edit draft of a finished, editable version, creating it if you have none.

get.description: One of your edit drafts.

put.description: Saves the full list of edits as the next rev. rev must match the draft, for multi-tab safety.

delete.description: Discards one of your edit drafts.

post.description: Renders your draft as the next version, unchanged: the run checks and renders and never redesigns. Recorded narration is mixed over the kept visuals.

Moves your draft's narration onto your draft of version toN (opened, or created), saved and checked like any save: the narration lock, the recordings you may use and the limits against that version. Your other draft is kept.

get.description: A short-lived link to play the draft's current rev in the sandboxed preview.
Who is editing this video's narration, if anyone.

post.description: Takes the video's narration lock for your draft, or heartbeats it (every 30 s; it lapses after 2 min without one). Only the holder saves narration ops.

409.description: Someone else is editing the narration (narration_locked; details: holder, takenOverBy, at)

delete.description: Releases your narration lock; someone else's is left alone.

post.description: Moves the narration lock to you, whoever holds it. Their draft is kept; their next heartbeat or narration save is refused and says you took over.
Uploads one file up to 4 MB as the request body: images, SVG, fonts, short clips. Bigger files use upload sessions.

get.description: The team's media library, newest first, plus your own uploads still being checked.

schema.description: Words to find in the title, file name, notes, source title or creator

parameters.description: Words to find in the title, file name, notes, source title or creator
parameters.name: q

schema.description: Your voice-over recordings: listed with the rest (include, the default), only, or left out

parameters.description: Your voice-over recordings: listed with the rest (include, the default), only, or left out
parameters.name: recordings

post.description: Before uploading, finds what the library already has for each file: the same file (by sha256) or a different file with the same name.

get.description: The voice-over recordings made for this video or used on it that you can read: your own, and the ones its versions (or their uploader's drafts) use. Newest first, with where each is used and how long it's kept, so a recording whose draft expired can be placed again.

post.description: Deletes your voice-over recordings that no draft or version uses, at once (they're otherwise kept 30 days after their last use). Recordings in use are kept.

Starts an upload session for a file over 4 MB, or for any voice-over recording. Declare its size and sha256 (a recorder may send the hash it computed while recording; the server checks every part and the whole file); quota is reserved. A recording names its role and the video it's for (scopeJobId), which you must be able to see.

role.description: A voice-over recording (take) or uploaded narration

scopeJobId.description: The video a recording is for (required with role)

413.description: Recordings storage full (details: quotaBytes, usedBytes, remainingBytes)

429.description: Too many uploads in progress, or too many recordings this hour

get.description: An upload session: which parts arrived (to resume) and its status.

delete.description: Cancels an unfinished upload session and frees its parts and quota.

put.description: Sends one part (at most 4 MB) as the request body; x-part-sha256 guards against corruption.

post.description: The file is assembled and checked in the background; poll the session or the item. A recording's whole-file sha256 is checked first: a mismatch is a 400 and the session fails.

poster.description: Base64 JPEG poster for a clip

413.description: Recordings storage full (details: quotaBytes, usedBytes, remainingBytes)

get.description: Searches Openverse for CC0 or CC BY audio (music by default); NC, ND and SA licences are never returned. Creators and admins. When Openverse is slow, answers 202 with a job to poll.

schema.description: cc0 (no credit needed) or cc0,by (the default; CC BY tracks are credited)

parameters.description: cc0 (no credit needed) or cc0,by (the default; CC BY tracks are credited)
parameters.name: license

schema.description: music (the default), sound_effect, or all audio

parameters.description: music (the default), sound_effect, or all audio
parameters.name: category

200.description: Tracks: fresh, or from an identical search in the last two weeks (stale after a day, then refreshed in the background)

202.description: Openverse is slow: poll the job (the Location header) for the tracks

429.description: Openverse is busy, or too many searches this minute

get.description: Audio already in the team library that matches music search words (title, caption, filename, creator or source), answered at once without asking Openverse.
Common music searches, kept warm every day: quick picks that answer at once.

post.description: Imports an Openverse track into the library by its id: re-read from Openverse, licence checked, file downloaded and verified as audio. Importing it again returns the same item. When Openverse is slow, answers 202 with a job to poll.

202.description: Importing in the background: poll the job (the Location header)

429.description: Openverse is busy, or too many imports this minute

502.description: Openverse or the track's host didn't answer

get.description: An Openverse search or import running in the background: its status, then the tracks or the library item. Only for the person who started it.
One media item.

patch.description: Changes the title (the name shown in the library) or the caption (notes the planner and agent read). Uploader or admin. Leave a field out to keep it; null clears it.

delete.description: Removes it from the library (uploader or admin); versions that used it keep it.

put.description: Stores a recording's waveform peaks (peaks.bin, the VAPK format, at most 256 KB) as the request body. Only the uploader, before or after the recording is ready; sending again replaces them.

get.description: A recording's waveform peaks (peaks.bin), for anyone who can read the recording.

put.description: Stores where the voice is in a recording, as [start, end) spans in source samples. Only the uploader, before or after the recording is ready; sending again replaces them.

get.description: Where the voice is in a recording, for anyone who can read the recording.
Comments on a video (optionally one version), oldest first, with your unread count.

post.description: Comments on a version, optionally pinned to a moment (timeSec) and a spot (x, y).

post.summary: Post several notes as one block
post.description: Posts notes from one pass through the video (each optionally at a moment and a spot) as one review block: one comment per note, sharing a groupId. The owner gets one notification.
Marks this video's comments read: all, or up to a time.

patch.description: Edit your comment, or resolve or reopen one (video owner or admin).

delete.description: Deletes your comment, or any comment on your video (owner or admin).

post.description: Transfers videos to another Creator or Admin: some videos, or all of a person's. Admins only.

get.description: Runs, queue, failures and credits. Admins only.

post.description: Marks an unresolved start as failed and frees its slot. Admins only.
Resumes a queue paused because AI credits were unavailable. Admins only.
